Observations.Detail: excludeUsers: 1. Exclusions can be intentional, including emergency access. Membership and effective coverage were not evaluated.

Observations.Title: Conditional Access policy is not enabled
Observations.Detail: Stored state: enabledForReportingButNotEnforced. Disabled/report-only policies do not enforce their configured grant controls.

Observations.Title: Conditional Access policy is not enabled
Observations.Detail: Stored state: disabled. Disabled/report-only policies do not enforce their configured grant controls.

Observations.Title: Policy has user, group or role exclusions
Observations.Detail: excludeGroups: 1. Exclusions can be intentional, including emergency access. Membership and effective coverage were not evaluated.

Observations.Title: Security defaults are disabled
Observations.Detail: This can be expected when Conditional Access is used. Review the intended alternative; this observation alone is not a security failure.

Observations.Title: Default users may register applications
Observations.Detail: Confirm this matches the organization policy. Existing app permissions and credentials were not collected.
